mapper.select: insert into eas_core_account_history (core_history_id, contract_id, contract_number, contract_name, account_id, account_code, account_number, sum_cr_amount, sum_dr_amount, biz_date, check_date, status, eas_contract_code ) select eas_core_account_history_s.nextval, v.contract_id, (select cc.contract_number from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = v.contract_id) contract_number, (select cc.contract_name from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = v.contract_id) contract_name, v.account_id, (select gc.account_code from gld_account gc where gc.account_id = v.account_id) account_code, (select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id=v.company_id ) account_number, v.sum_cr_amount, v.sum_dr_amount, v.je_creation_date biz_date, #{checkDate}, (select fc.eas_code from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code=v.currency)currency_code, (select cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = v.contract_id) eas_contract_code from (select t.account_id, cc.contract_id, trunc(gh.je_creation_date) as je_creation_date, sum(nvl(t.cr_amount, 0)) sum_cr_amount, sum(nvl(t.dr_amount, 0)) sum_dr_amount, gh.company_id, gh.currency from gld_je_line t, con_contract cc,gld_je_head gh where t.segment_3 = cc.contract_number and cc.data_class='NORMAL' and t.je_head_id=gh.je_head_id and t.account_id is not null and gh.je_creation_date=#{checkDate} and gh.gl_status in ('DELETE_FAILURE','SYN') group by t.account_id, cc.contract_id,trunc(gh.je_creation_date),gh.company_id,gh.currency) v

insert into hls_check_account_history (history_id, contract_id, contract_number, contract_name, account_id, account_code, account_number, sum_cr_amount, sum_dr_amount, check_date, day_balance, after_balance, before_balance, status, eas_contract_code ) select hls_check_account_history_s.nextval, v.contract_id, (select cc.contract_number from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = v.contract_id) contract_number, (select cc.contract_name from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = v.contract_id) contract_name, v.account_id, (select gc.account_code from gld_account gc where gc.account_id = v.account_id) account_code, (select fc.ws_com_code from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id=v.company_id)as account_number, v.sum_cr_amount, v.sum_dr_amount, #{checkDate} as check_date, case when (select ga.borrowing_direction from gld_account ga where ga.account_id=v.account_id)='BORROW' then (select sum(nvl(t2.dr_functional_amount, 0) - nvl(t2.cr_functional_amount, 0)) from gld_je_head t1, gld_je_line t2, con_contract ccc where t1.je_head_id = t2.je_head_id and t2.segment_3 = ccc.contract_number and ccc.contract_id = v.contract_id and t1.je_creation_date =#{checkDate} and t2.account_id = v.account_id and t1.je_status ='CONFIRM' and t1.company_id=v.company_id and t1.currency=v.currency ) ELSE (select sum(nvl(t2.cr_functional_amount, 0) - nvl(t2.dr_functional_amount, 0)) from gld_je_head t1, gld_je_line t2, con_contract ccc where t1.je_head_id = t2.je_head_id and t2.segment_3 = ccc.contract_number and ccc.contract_id = v.contract_id and t1.je_creation_date =#{checkDate} and t2.account_id = v.account_id and t1.je_status ='CONFIRM' and t1.company_id=v.company_id and t1.currency=v.currency ) end day_balance,
case when (select ga.borrowing_direction from gld_account ga where ga.account_id=v.account_id)='BORROW' then (select sum(nvl(t2.dr_functional_amount, 0) - nvl(t2.cr_functional_amount, 0)) from gld_je_head t1, gld_je_line t2, con_contract ccc where t1.je_head_id = t2.je_head_id and t2.segment_3 = ccc.contract_number and ccc.contract_id = v.contract_id and to_date(t1.je_creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_date(#{checkDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') and t2.account_id = v.account_id and t1.je_status ='CONFIRM' and t1.company_id=v.company_id and t1.currency=v.currency ) ELSE (select sum(nvl(t2.cr_functional_amount, 0) - nvl(t2.dr_functional_amount, 0)) from gld_je_head t1, gld_je_line t2, con_contract ccc where t1.je_head_id = t2.je_head_id and t2.segment_3 = ccc.contract_number and ccc.contract_id = v.contract_id and to_date(t1.je_creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_date(#{checkDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') and t2.account_id = v.account_id and t1.je_status ='CONFIRM' and t1.company_id=v.company_id and t1.currency=v.currency ) end after_balance,
case when (select ga.borrowing_direction from gld_account ga where ga.account_id=v.account_id)='BORROW' then (select sum(nvl(t2.dr_functional_amount, 0) - nvl(t2.cr_functional_amount, 0)) from gld_je_head t1, gld_je_line t2, con_contract ccc where t1.je_head_id = t2.je_head_id and t2.segment_3 = ccc.contract_number and ccc.contract_id = v.contract_id and to_date(t1.je_creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= adddate(to_date(#{checkDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),-1) and t2.account_id = v.account_id and t1.je_status ='CONFIRM' and t1.company_id=v.company_id and t1.currency=v.currency ) ELSE (select sum(nvl(t2.cr_functional_amount, 0) - nvl(t2.dr_functional_amount, 0)) from gld_je_head t1, gld_je_line t2, con_contract ccc where t1.je_head_id = t2.je_head_id and t2.segment_3 = ccc.contract_number and ccc.contract_id = v.contract_id and to_date(t1.je_creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= adddate(to_date(#{checkDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),-1) and t2.account_id = v.account_id and t1.je_status ='CONFIRM' and t1.company_id=v.company_id and t1.currency=v.currency ) end before_balance, (select fc.eas_code from fnd_currency fc where fc.currency_code= v.currency)currency, (select cc.eas_code from con_contract cc where cc.contract_id = v.contract_id) eas_contract_code from (select t.account_id, cc.contract_id, sum(nvl(t.cr_functional_amount, 0)) sum_cr_amount, sum(nvl(t.dr_functional_amount, 0)) sum_dr_amount, gh.company_id, gh.currency from gld_je_line t, con_contract cc, gld_je_head gh where t.segment_3 = cc.contract_number and cc.data_class='NORMAL' and t.je_head_id = gh.je_head_id and t.account_id is not null and gh.je_creation_date=#{checkDate} and gh.je_status ='CONFIRM' group by t.account_id, cc.contract_id,gh.company_id,gh.currency) v

select v.* from (select tt.*, case when nvl(tt.day_balance,0)=nvl(tt.eas_day_balance,0) and nvl(tt.after_balance,0)=nvl(tt.eas_after_balance,0) and nvl(tt.before_balance,0)=nvl(tt.eas_before_balance,0) then '是' else '否' end is_same, abs(nvl(tt.after_balance,0)-nvl(tt.eas_after_balance,0)) as different_balance from (select hc.account_code, (select ga.account_name from gld_account ga where ga.account_code = hc.account_code) account_name, hc.contract_number, hc.check_date, nvl(hc.day_balance,0) as day_balance, nvl(hc.after_balance,0) as after_balance, nvl(hc.before_balance,0) as before_balance, (select sum(nvl(t2.day_balance, 0)) from eas_account_history t2 where t2.acct_num = hc.account_code and t2.contract_no = hc.eas_contract_code and t2.account_number=hc.account_number and t2.companynumber=hc.status and t2.check_date = hc.check_date) eas_day_balance, (select sum(nvl(t2.after_balance, 0)) from eas_account_history t2 where t2.acct_num = hc.account_code and t2.contract_no = hc.eas_contract_code and t2.account_number=hc.account_number and t2.companynumber=hc.status and t2.check_date = hc.check_date) eas_after_balance, (select sum(nvl(t2.before_balance, 0)) from eas_account_history t2 where t2.acct_num = hc.account_code and t2.contract_no = hc.eas_contract_code and t2.account_number=hc.account_number and t2.companynumber=hc.status and t2.check_date = hc.check_date) eas_before_balance, (select fc.currency_name from fnd_currency fc where fc.eas_code=hc.status)currency_name, (select fc.fin_company_name from fnd_company fc where fc.ws_com_code=hc.account_number)company_name
from hls_check_account_history hc where hc.check_date = #{checkDate})tt)v
where 1=1
AND v.account_name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{accountName}),'%')
AND v.contract_number LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
AND v.is_same LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{isSame}),'%')
delete from eas_core_account_history t where t.check_date=#{checkDate}
delete from hls_check_account_history t where t.check_date=#{checkDate}
delete from eas_account_history t where t.check_date=#{checkDate}
